main_defect: Step 2 has no Cynefin domain while the Self-test claims every action has one; citations are numbered out of order ([2] appears before [1]); the Self-test reports a longest sentence of 24 words when the check report finds 35.

R1.evidence: Step 1 'Domain: Complicated', Step 3 'Domain: Complex', Step 4 'Domain: Clear', but Step 2 ('Measure the baseline') states only 'Task kind: evaluative' with no Cynefin domain. Stated domains also lack one-line reasons.

R2.evidence: All stated domains are correct: building the labelled eval set as Complicated, tuning as Complex ('Domain: Complex, leverage is a guess'), the release gate as Clear. Includes the expected action tagged 'stochastic... Domain: Complex' (Step 3).

R3.evidence: Step 3 is a safe-to-fail probe with measure ('factual accuracy 95% or better, n = 200'), budget ('cap each probe at two working sessions'), and a stop condition; Step 4 Clear action is one step with Gherkin test; Step 1 Complicated action names its analysis (rubric with weights) first. Stop condition for Step 3 is named but not specified in detail.

R4.evidence: Measure-building steps come first and reduce the probe's uncertainty ('Step 2 MUST NOT start until the rubric in Step 1 passes'); the Complex probe (Step 3) is capped and the Clear gate 'runs in parallel with Step 3 because it needs no tuning result', matching the trade-off rules.

R5.evidence: Evaluative steps use a rubric with criteria, weights ('factual accuracy 50%, completeness 30%, actionability 20%'), and pass threshold ('90%'); stochastic Step 3 states metric, baseline, threshold, and sample size ('factual accuracy 95% or better, n = 200, baseline from Step 2'); deterministic Step 4 uses Gherkin ('Given a new summariser version, When it scores below the Step 3 threshold... Then deployment is blocked').

R6.evidence: Avoids the likely wrong answer of analysing unrecorded failures: 'No quantitative baseline exists, so the first gap is measurement, not model choice' and Step 1 creates the record (200 labelled conversations) before any tuning; the tuning step is named Complex with 'leverage is a guess'.

R7.evidence: 'No open questions' in Follow-up; zero questions asked, consistent with the material, and assumptions were logged instead (A1-A3).

R8.evidence: 'Confidence in the plan: high, two of three steps are Clear or Complicated. Confidence in the 95% threshold: medium, it needs Step 2 baseline data to confirm it is reachable' — confidence levels with stated basis; leverage explicitly marked a guess.

R9.evidence: Full structure present (Headline, Background, Relevance, Information, End beginning 'I recommend that we', Follow-up, Self-test); zero banned words and zero dashes per check report. Defects: citations numbered out of order (first appearance 2, 1, 3) with script flagging 'citation with no reference'; two sentences exceed limits (35 and 33 words); Self-test inconsistent with the response (reports longest sentence 24 words; claims every action has a Cynefin domain though Step 2 has none).
